LESSON: GROWING TREES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Conservation of Resources
Topic 1.4: Growing Trees

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Growing Trees. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can growing trees conserve the environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment
2. plant trees to conserve the environment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GROWING TREES
Subject: AGRICULTURE · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Growing Trees helps you succeed in AGRICULTURE. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: GROWING TREES
Study Growing Trees like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Growing Trees” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Plant trees to conserve the environment

What this means
In this part you learn to plant trees to conserve the environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: plant trees to conserve the environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Say why Growing Trees matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can plant trees to conserve the environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Growing Trees is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Growing Trees” around your school. (skill: explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment)

Example 2: Say why Growing Trees matters for health, safety, or the environment in Kenya. (skill: plant trees to conserve the environment)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Growing Trees to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment.
3. Practise this skill: plant trees to conserve the environment.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Growing Trees from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Growing Trees: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Growing Trees?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can growing trees conserve the environment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Growing Trees means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment.
5. Be able to: plant trees to conserve the environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
